question: What is the process for applying for a vacation day at ShopUNow?
answer: To request a vacation day, log into the ShopUNow HR portal and navigate to the Leave Request section. Select the desired date(s), choose "Vacation" as the leave type, and submit. Your immediate manager will receive a notification and must approve the request within 48 hours. Once approved, the portal will update your leave balance and the calendar will reflect your absence. If you need to adjust dates after approval, submit a new request and the manager will review it again.

question: How does ShopUNow handle health insurance for full-time employees?
answer: Full-time employees are automatically enrolled in ShopUNow's Group Health Plan, which includes medical, dental, and vision coverage. The plan is funded 70% by the company and 30% by the employee through payroll deductions. You can view your plan details and claim status in the HR portal under Benefits. For any questions about coverage limits or provider networks, contact the benefits team at benefits@shopunow.com.

question: What are the guidelines for remote work eligibility?
answer: ShopUNow allows remote work for employees who have completed at least 12 months of continuous service and whose roles can be performed off-site. To apply, submit a Remote Work Request via the HR portal, detailing your proposed schedule and home office setup. Your manager and the IT department will review the request. Approved employees receive a stipend for home office equipment and must attend quarterly virtual check-ins.

question: How can I access my performance review feedback?
answer: After each performance review cycle, your manager uploads feedback to the HR portal. Log in, go to the Performance section, and click on the most recent review. You will see a summary of strengths, areas for improvement, and any action items. If you have questions, schedule a meeting with your manager through the portal's calendar feature.

question: What is the policy on overtime pay for retail associates?
answer: Retail associates who work beyond their scheduled 40 hours per week are eligible for overtime at 1.5 times their regular hourly rate. Overtime must be pre-approved by the store manager and recorded in the time-tracking system. Unapproved overtime will not be compensated. For any disputes, contact the payroll office at payroll@shopunow.com.

question: How do I enroll in the ShopUNow Employee Assistance Program?
answer: The Employee Assistance Program (EAP) is available to all employees and offers confidential counseling, financial planning, and legal advice. To enroll, go to the Benefits section of the HR portal, select EAP, and complete the short enrollment form. Once enrolled, you will receive a welcome packet with contact information and usage guidelines.

question: What steps should I take if I notice a violation of the code of conduct?
answer: If you observe a potential code of conduct violation, report it immediately through the anonymous Hotline at 1-800-555-1234 or via the HR portal's Confidential Report form. All reports are investigated by the Compliance Team, and the identity of the reporter is protected. You will receive a summary of the outcome if you consent to be informed.

question: Can I transfer to a different store location?
answer: Store transfers are considered on a case-by-case basis. Submit a Transfer Request through the HR portal, including your preferred location and reason for transfer. The HR and Store Operations teams will review the request, taking into account staffing needs and your performance record. If approved, you will receive a transfer notice and a new schedule within two weeks.

question: What is the policy on employee referrals?
answer: ShopUNow offers a referral bonus of $1,000 for each successful hire referred by an employee. To submit a referral, use the Referral Form in the HR portal, providing the candidate's resume and a brief note on why they're a good fit. Once the candidate is hired and completes 90 days of employment, the bonus will be added to your next payroll.

question: How do I update my personal contact information in the HR system?
answer: Log into the HR portal, navigate to My Profile, and click "Edit Personal Info." Update your phone number, email, and emergency contact details. Save changes, and the system will send a confirmation email. If you encounter any issues, contact HR support at hr@shopunow.com.

question: What training resources are available for career development?
answer: ShopUNow provides a Learning Management System (LMS) with courses on leadership, customer service, and product knowledge. Access the LMS via the HR portal, select the "Career Development" tab, and enroll in courses that match your career goals. Managers can also recommend specific training modules during performance reviews.

question: How does ShopUNow handle payroll deductions for union dues?
answer: Employees who are members of a union can opt to have union dues deducted from their paycheck. To set this up, complete the Union Dues Authorization form in the HR portal. The payroll team will process the deduction each pay period and provide a statement in your pay stub. If you wish to cancel, submit a new authorization form.

question: How do I apply for PTO at ShopUNow?
answer: To request PTO, log into the ShopUNow HR portal and navigate to the Leave Request section. Select the desired date or dates, choose "Vacation" as the leave type, and submit the request. Your immediate manager will receive a notification and must approve the request within 48 hours. Once approved, your leave balance and absence calendar will be updated.

question: Where can I submit a paid time off request?
answer: Paid time off requests are submitted through the ShopUNow HR portal. Open the Leave Request section, select the dates you need, choose the appropriate leave type, and submit the request. Your manager will review the request and must approve it before the leave is recorded.

question: How far in advance should I request vacation time?
answer: ShopUNow employees should submit vacation requests through the HR portal before taking leave. The request is routed to the immediate manager for approval, and managers are expected to respond within 48 hours. Employees should submit requests as early as practical to allow time for scheduling.

question: How can I check my remaining vacation balance?
answer: Log into the ShopUNow HR portal and open the Leave Request section. Your current leave balance is displayed there. Approved vacation requests are automatically reflected in the balance after manager approval.

question: Who approves my vacation request?
answer: Your immediate manager approves vacation requests submitted through the ShopUNow HR portal. The manager receives a notification when you submit the request and is expected to approve or review it within 48 hours.

question: Can I change my vacation dates after my request is approved?
answer: Yes. If you need to change dates after approval, submit a new leave request through the HR portal. Your manager will review the new request again.

question: How do I find my employee benefits information?
answer: Log into the ShopUNow HR portal and open the Benefits section. Full-time employees can view Group Health Plan information, including medical, dental, and vision coverage. The benefits team can answer questions about coverage limits and provider networks.

question: How can I request a work-from-home arrangement?
answer: Employees who have completed at least 12 months of continuous service and whose roles can be performed off-site can submit a Remote Work Request through the HR portal. Include your proposed schedule and home office setup. The request is reviewed by your manager and IT.

question: How do I reset my ShopUNow employee VPN password?
answer: To reset your VPN password, log in to the ShopUNow Employee Portal and navigate to "Account Settings" > "Security". Click "Reset VPN Password" and follow the on-screen instructions. You will receive a temporary password via the corporate email you used to register. Use this temporary password to log in, then set a new password that meets the company policy.

question: What should I do if my laptop is running slow after the latest Windows update?
answer: First, run the built-in Windows Troubleshooter. If the issue persists, check for pending updates and install them. Then, open Task Manager and look for processes consuming excessive CPU or memory. Run disk cleanup and contact IT for a hardware check if the laptop remains slow.

question: How can I access the ShopUNow internal wiki from my mobile device?
answer: Download the ShopUNow Wiki app from the Apple App Store or Google Play Store. Log in using your corporate credentials through single sign-on. Once authenticated, you can view, edit, and search wiki pages from your mobile device.

question: I received a phishing email claiming to be from the Finance department. What steps should I take?
answer: Do not click links or download attachments. Mark the email as "Phishing" in Outlook using the Report button. Then forward the email to it-support@shopunow.com with the subject line "Phishing Report – Finance Department." IT will investigate.

question: How do I set up a shared printer for the Marketing team?
answer: Connect the printer to the office network and ensure it is powered on. In the IT portal, go to "Devices" > "Printers" and select "Add Printer." Enter the printer's IP address and appropriate driver, then add the Marketing_Users group under shared users.

question: What is the procedure for requesting a new software license for a design tool?
answer: Submit a Software License Request Form through the IT Service Desk portal. Include the software name, version, number of seats, and business justification. After IT Manager approval, the license will be added to your account.

question: My email client is not syncing new messages. How can I fix it?
answer: Check your internet connection first. In Outlook, open File > Account Settings and select Repair for your account. If the problem continues, contact IT so they can verify your mailbox quota and server status.

question: How do I enable two-factor authentication for my ShopUNow account?
answer: Navigate to the ShopUNow Employee Portal and select Security Settings. Choose "Enable Two-Factor Authentication" and select an authenticator app or SMS. Follow the verification instructions to complete setup.

question: I need to backup my project files to the company cloud. What steps should I follow?
answer: Open ShopUNow Cloud Drive (OneDrive for Business) and create a project folder. Upload your files and share the folder with the relevant project team members. For large files, use the Upload button.

question: Why am I receiving repeated error 0x80070005 when installing updates?
answer: Error 0x80070005 indicates a permissions issue. Run the Windows Update Troubleshooter. If the issue remains, run "sfc /scannow" from an administrator Command Prompt, restart the computer, and try the update again. Contact IT if the problem continues.

question: How can I configure my laptop to automatically lock after 15 minutes of inactivity?
answer: Open Settings > Personalization > Lock screen > Screen timeout settings and set the screen timeout to 15 minutes for both battery and plugged-in use. Also enable the requirement for sign-in after the computer wakes.

question: What should I do if I suspect a coworker is accessing my shared folder without permission?
answer: Review the folder's access permissions and remove unauthorized users. Then log a security incident through the IT Service Desk with details of the suspected access. IT will audit access logs and investigate.

question: How do I reset my ShopUNow account password?
answer: Open the ShopUNow Employee Portal and go to Account Settings > Security. Use the password reset option and follow the verification instructions. Your new password must meet ShopUNow's password requirements.

question: What should I do if I cannot connect to the company Wi-Fi?
answer: First verify that Wi-Fi is enabled on your device and reconnect to the ShopUNow network. Restart the device if necessary. If you still cannot connect, contact the IT Service Desk so they can check your account and the network connection.

question: How can I request access to an internal application?
answer: Submit an access request through the IT Service Desk portal. Include the application name, your business justification, and the access level required. IT will review the request and provide access after approval.

question: What should I do if my employee account is locked?
answer: If your ShopUNow employee account is locked, use the account recovery option in the Employee Portal. If self-service recovery is unavailable, contact the IT Service Desk for assistance with unlocking the account.

question: How do I request a replacement company laptop?
answer: Submit a hardware support request through the IT Service Desk portal. Describe the problem with your current laptop and include your device information. IT will assess whether repair or replacement is appropriate.

question: Where can I report a suspicious email?
answer: Use Outlook's Report button to mark the message as phishing, and forward the suspicious email to it-support@shopunow.com. Do not click links or download attachments from the suspicious message.

question: How do I request temporary software access?
answer: Submit a Software License Request through the IT Service Desk and specify that temporary access is required. Include the software name, requested duration, and business justification. IT will review the request and provide access if approved.

question: How do I secure my ShopUNow laptop when I leave my desk?
answer: Configure your laptop to lock automatically after 15 minutes of inactivity and enable sign-in after the computer wakes. You should also manually lock the device whenever you leave your workstation unattended.

question: How do I view my recent invoices on ShopUNow?
answer: Log in to your ShopUNow account, go to the "Orders" tab, and click on the "Invoices" sub-section. You can view invoice dates, amounts, and status and download invoices as PDF files.

question: What payment methods does ShopUNow accept for my subscription?
answer: ShopUNow accepts major credit cards including Visa, MasterCard, and American Express, debit cards, PayPal, and Apple Pay. Corporate accounts can also use ACH transfers and wire payments.

question: I was charged twice for the same order. How can I get a refund?
answer: Check your order history to confirm the duplicate charge. If it is a duplicate, contact support through the chat widget or support@shopunow.com. Provide the order ID, transaction ID, and a screenshot. Refunds are normally issued within 3–5 business days.

question: Can I set up automatic recurring payments for my monthly subscription?
answer: Yes. Open Billing Settings and enable the Auto-Renew option for your subscription. You can turn off auto-renew at any time to stop renewal at the end of the current billing cycle.

question: What is the refund policy for digital products purchased on ShopUNow?
answer: Digital products are non-refundable once downloaded. If a product is defective or not as described, you can request a refund within 7 days by contacting support with your order ID and explanation.

question: How do I update my billing address?
answer: Navigate to Account Settings > Billing Address, enter the new address, and select Save Changes. The updated address applies to future invoices and shipping labels.

question: I received a partial refund that doesn't match the original amount. What should I do?
answer: Check the refund email for the transaction ID. Differences may result from a promotional discount or partial return. Contact support with the order ID and refund ID so the discrepancy can be reviewed.

question: Can I pay my invoice in installments?
answer: ShopUNow offers a 3-month installment plan for invoices over $200. Open the invoice page, select Pay in Installments, and follow the prompts to enroll.

question: What should I do if my credit card was declined during checkout?
answer: Verify that your card has sufficient funds and that the billing address matches the address on file. If the problem persists, try another card or PayPal. You can also contact your bank or ShopUNow support.

question: How can I export my purchase history for tax purposes?
answer: In the Orders section, select Export History. Choose your date range and CSV or PDF format. The exported file includes order IDs, dates, amounts, and tax details.

question: Is there a discount for paying annually instead of monthly?
answer: Yes. Paying annually saves 15% compared with the monthly rate. Go to Billing Settings, select the annual plan, and confirm the payment. The discount applies to the next billing cycle.

question: How do I dispute a charge that I don't recognize?
answer: First check your order history. If the charge remains unexplained, open a dispute through the chat widget or email support@shopunow.com with the transaction ID and a description. ShopUNow will investigate with the payment processor.

question: How can I request a refund for an eligible purchase?
answer: Contact ShopUNow support through the chat widget or support@shopunow.com and provide your order ID along with the reason for the refund. Support will review the request according to the applicable refund policy.

question: Where can I change the credit card used for my subscription?
answer: Open your ShopUNow account and navigate to Billing Settings. From there you can add or change the payment method used for your subscription.

question: How long does a duplicate-charge refund take?
answer: After ShopUNow confirms that a charge is a duplicate, the refund is normally issued within 3–5 business days. Provide the order ID and transaction ID when contacting support.

question: Can I use PayPal to pay for my ShopUNow subscription?
answer: Yes. PayPal is one of the accepted payment methods for ShopUNow subscriptions. You can select PayPal when choosing or updating your payment method in Billing Settings.

question: How can I download a copy of my invoice?
answer: Log in to your ShopUNow account, open Orders, and select the Invoices subsection. Choose the invoice you need and download it as a PDF.

question: What should I do if the amount refunded to me is incorrect?
answer: Review the refund email and identify the transaction and refund IDs. Then contact ShopUNow support with your order ID and refund information so the discrepancy can be investigated.

question: How do I turn off automatic subscription renewal?
answer: Go to Billing Settings and turn off the Auto-Renew option. Your subscription will remain active until the end of the current billing cycle.

question: What information should I provide when reporting an unfamiliar charge?
answer: Provide the transaction ID, a description of the unfamiliar charge, and any relevant order information. You can submit the dispute through the ShopUNow chat widget or by emailing support@shopunow.com.

question: What shipping options does ShopUNow offer for my order?
answer: ShopUNow offers Standard shipping, which takes 5–7 business days, Express shipping, which takes 2–3 business days, and Same-Day delivery within the specified service area. Standard shipping is free for orders over $75.

question: How can I track my shipment once it has shipped?
answer: After your order ships, you will receive a confirmation email containing a tracking number and carrier link. You can also log in to ShopUNow, open My Orders, and select Track Package.

question: What happens if I'm not home when my package arrives?
answer: If you are unavailable, the carrier will leave a delivery notice with instructions for redelivery or pickup. For Same-Day deliveries, contact support within 24 hours if you need assistance with the delivery window.

question: Can I change my shipping address after placing an order?
answer: You can change your shipping address within 2 hours of placing an order through the order details page. After that period, contact customer support as soon as possible to determine whether the address can still be changed before shipment.

question: What is ShopUNow's return policy for items that arrive damaged?
answer: Take photos of the damaged item and packaging and contact support within 48 hours of delivery. ShopUNow will provide a prepaid return label and arrange a replacement or refund. The return shipping cost is covered for damaged items.

question: Do you ship internationally?
answer: Yes. ShopUNow ships to Canada, Mexico, and the United Kingdom. International orders are generally processed with DHL Express and typically arrive within 7–10 business days. Customs duties are the responsibility of the recipient.

question: What should I do if my package is delayed?
answer: Check the tracking information first. If the status shows Delayed or Out for Delivery but has not changed for 24 hours, contact ShopUNow support with your order number. Support will investigate with the carrier and provide an updated ETA.

question: Can I choose a pickup location instead of home delivery?
answer: Yes. During checkout, select the Pickup option and choose your preferred ShopUNow retail location. You will receive a pickup confirmation email when the order is ready.

question: What is the estimated delivery time for a Standard shipment to Denver?
answer: Standard shipping to Denver is estimated at 5–7 business days from the date the order ships. Tracking becomes available once the package leaves the ShopUNow warehouse.

question: How do I cancel a shipment that hasn't shipped yet?
answer: Log into your ShopUNow account, open My Orders, and select Cancel Order. If the order is still processing, it can be cancelled and a full refund will be issued. If it has shipped, follow the return process after delivery.

question: Do you offer free shipping for first-time customers?
answer: Yes. First-time customers receive free Standard shipping on orders over $50. Orders below $50 have a flat $5.99 Standard shipping fee. Express and Same-Day shipping are excluded from this promotion.

question: What happens if I miss the delivery window for Same-Day shipping?
answer: If you miss the Same-Day delivery window, the carrier will leave a notice and attempt another delivery within the next 24 hours. You can also contact support to request a reschedule or pickup option.

question: How do I find my tracking number?
answer: After your order ships, ShopUNow sends a confirmation email containing your tracking number and the carrier's website link. You can also find the tracking number by opening My Orders and selecting Track Package.

question: Where can I see the current status of my delivery?
answer: Log into your ShopUNow account, open My Orders, and select Track Package for the relevant order. The tracking information shows the current delivery status and available carrier updates.

question: Can someone else receive my ShopUNow package?
answer: You can authorize a trusted neighbor to receive a package by adding their name in the delivery instructions during checkout. Availability may depend on the carrier and delivery method.

question: How long do I have to report a damaged delivery?
answer: Contact ShopUNow support within 48 hours of delivery if an item arrives damaged. Include photos of the item and packaging so the support team can arrange a replacement or refund.

question: What countries can ShopUNow deliver to internationally?
answer: ShopUNow currently ships internationally to Canada, Mexico, and the United Kingdom. International shipping fees depend on destination and package weight.

question: How quickly can I receive an Express shipment?
answer: Express shipping typically takes 2–3 business days. The available shipping methods and final delivery estimate are displayed during checkout.

question: Can I pick up my order from a ShopUNow store?
answer: Yes. Select the Pickup option during checkout and choose your preferred ShopUNow retail location. The order is normally ready for collection within 24 hours of order confirmation.

question: Can I cancel my order before it is shipped?
answer: Yes. Open My Orders in your ShopUNow account and select Cancel Order while the order is still processing. A full refund will be issued for an eligible cancellation.
